question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
-- For each actor (trimmed name) who worked with Yash Chopra, find their max collaboration count with any other director
WITH yash_actors AS (
    SELECT TRIM(p.Name) AS actor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT md.MID) AS yash_count
    FROM M_Director md
    JOIN Person p_dir ON md.PID = p_dir.PID
    JOIN M_Cast mc ON md.MID = mc.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
    WHERE p_dir.PID = 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY TRIM(p.Name)
),
actor_director_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        TRIM(p.Name) AS actor_name,
        p_dir.Name AS director_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT md.MID) AS film_count
    FROM M_Director md
    JOIN Person p_dir ON md.PID = p_dir.PID
    JOIN M_Cast mc ON md.MID = mc.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
    WHERE p_dir.PID != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY TRIM(p.Name), p_dir.Name
),
max_other_counts AS (
    SELECT actor_name, MAX(film_count) AS max_other
    FROM actor_director_counts
    GROUP BY actor_name
)
SELECT 
    ya.actor_name,
    ya.yash_count,
    COALESCE(moc.max_other, 0) AS max_other_count,
    CASE WHEN ya.yash_count > COALESCE(moc.max_other, 0) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS is_most
FROM yash_actors ya
LEFT JOIN max_other_counts moc ON ya.actor_name = moc.actor_name
WHERE ya.yash_count > COALESCE(moc.max_other, 0)
ORDER BY ya.yash_count DESC
